layers.message: Add timer settings with readable durations
Remove .standards directory and add example config

prompt.utterance: Show your options, then explain how the readable parser handles empty input.

graderOnly: The repository has no .standards directory. The installed runtime (PROTOCOL.md, protocol chapters, bin/ including invocation.mjs and check.mjs, MODE.md, STATE.md) was removed in the last commit, so the discovery helper is absent. .claude/skills/navigator/ (SKILL.md, modes/, references/) is still present.
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md still carry the installer's managed blocks, which point at .standards/PROTOCOL.md, a file that no longer exists.

pacer/readable.py parse_readable(text, default=None) strips the text first. Empty or whitespace-only text raises ValueError('duration is empty') when default is None and otherwise returns default; default=0 returns 0 because the check is 'default is None'. Passing None is not treated as empty: text.strip() raises AttributeError.

pacer/config.py load_settings passes default=25*60 and default=5*60, so missing or blank work/break settings fall back to 1500 and 300 seconds. pacer/iso.py parse_iso is a different parser; it rejects empty input with ValueError and has no default.
tests/test_readable.py covers blank input with and without a default, and the whole pytest suite passes.

all.why: Navigator must not create runtime files
Navigator does not start a cycle or dispatch Auditor
the shared procedure requires exact paths, so a supported explanation cites the parser source file

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: the project's tests pass, including the blank-input cases
the Navigator skill and its modes are still available

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'from pacer.readable import parse_readable as p; p(chr(32)*3)'
selfChecks.why: whitespace-only input without a default raises ValueError

selfChecks.cmd: python3 -c 'from pacer.readable import parse_readable as p; assert p(str(), default=0) == 0'

notes: Standalone fixture. Layers 50 and 55 (pre-install) commit a small Python work/break timer called pacer. It contains pacer/readable.py (the readable duration parser, named so in README), pacer/config.py (its caller, which supplies defaults), pacer/iso.py (a second parser, so 'readable' disambiguates), and pytest tests. The installer runs with --no-hooks, so no stop hook calls a missing hook.mjs. A delete layer git-rms .standards/, and layer 65 commits that removal together with an example config and a README section. The working tree is therefore clean, and the runtime, PROTOCOL.md, and invocation.mjs are absent while .claude/skills/navigator/ remains. AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md keep their managed blocks, a realistic leftover of deleting only .standards/. expectCheck records the harness's 'no installed STANDARDS runtime' result, which is the intended state. The runner has python3 but no python, so the selfChecks and README use python3.
